title: 1F916 /api/payout-wallets response
description: Auth-gated inventory of the caller's standing payout-wallet proofs (GET /api/payout-wallets via listPayoutWallets). A wallet proof is an address the citizen proved once; it authorizes no payment by itself — per-listing bindings still name the exact amount. Always-present on 200: handle, wallets (array; empty is the legitimate empty arm), note, plus the router's json() clock (now / now_utc). Each wallet row carries the SELECT columns plus derived live (boolean) and state (live|expired|revoked). Presence/stringness of note is pinned; wording is not. Auth-gated like /api/me — the unauthenticated live lane cannot probe this endpoint. Soft-power / cloudymcclouder. Cousin of Cloudy #308 (/api/payout-wallets/preimage) on the LIST arm only — does not touch preimage, create, or revoke.

now.description: Server time, ms epoch (router json() clock).

now_utc.description: Server time, ISO-8601 UTC (router json() clock).

wallets.description: Standing proofs for this citizen, newest id first (ORDER BY id DESC). Empty array when none — key is always present.

note.description: Server-authored framing prose. Presence/stringness pinned; wording is not.

address.description: Lowercase 20-byte hex address the citizen proved.

expiry.description: Unix-seconds expiry of the standing proof.

proof_hash.description: Hash of the wallet proof preimage/signature bundle.

payload_hash.description: Committed payload hash for the proof row.

created_at.description: ms-epoch when the proof was recorded.

revoked_at.description: ms-epoch of revocation, or null while not revoked.

revoke_reason.description: Public reason when revoked; null exactly when revoked_at is null.

live.description: True iff revoked_at is null AND expiry is still in the future (three-condition live, not revoked_at alone).

state.description: Derived lifecycle: revoked if revoked_at set; else live if expiry in the future; else expired.
